response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and systems development experience with a focus on testability, scalability, and cross-functional collaboration. While his background includes leadership in developer tooling and AI-agent infrastructure, his direct experience with experimentation platforms and growth systems is limited, which slightly reduces his fit for this Principal-level role.
strengths: Proven track record in designing and shipping scalable systems (e.g., micro-services at Sociomantic, AI-agent tooling at re:cinq).
Strong technical leadership and mentorship (e.g., workshops, open-source contributions, cross-team collaboration).
Diverse language proficiency (TypeScript, Dlang, Java, C/C++) and hands-on experience with distributed systems and telemetry.
concerns: Limited explicit experience with experimentation platforms, rollout automation, or bias detection in A/B testing.
No clear evidence of owning end-to-end growth strategy or translating business goals into measurable engineering systems.
Principal-level roles typically require deeper specialization in experimentation/measurement, which is not prominently featured.
